police.name: Conway Police Department
police.address: 35 East Conway Road, Center Conway, NH 03813
police.oversight: Elected three-member Police Commission under the town charter; under state law (RSA 105-C) it appoints police personnel and sets their pay. Commissioners: Andre Pepin (chair), Rodney King and Bruce Ela.
police.logsNote: The department's Logs page links to a public Google Drive folder of daily dispatch logs. Agorri could not open the folder this session, so no digest is shown. The Conway Daily Sun also prints the log from time to time (latest seen: week of Oct. 3, posted Oct 9). Agorri does not republish names.

fire.name: North Conway Fire Department
fire.address: 70 Norcross Circle, North Conway, NH 03860 (mail: PO Box 218)
fire.oversight: Run by the North Conway Water Precinct, a separate local district with a three-member Board of Commissioners. Precinct voters approve spending at the annual precinct meeting.
fire.note: McCarthy became chief in 2022; Agorri found no 2026 source confirming he is still chief. A national fire department registry lists the department as a combination (career and call) department with three stations; only the Norcross Circle station address was found.

programs.name: Outdoor burning permits
programs.detail: Required for any outdoor fire unless the ground is snow-covered.

burnPermits.text: New Hampshire requires a written permit for outdoor burning unless the ground is covered with snow. Get one from the local Forest Fire Warden or fire department, or online at NHFirePermit.com if the town takes part. You must be 18 or older.
